# Travel Booking Policy

Business travel is booked through the Roamwell travel portal.

## Flights

Flights shorter than 6 hours are booked in economy. Longer flights may be booked in premium economy.

## Hotels

Hotels are capped at 240 US dollars per night, except in cities listed on the high-cost list.

## Booking window

Trips should be booked at least 14 days in advance. Bookings made later need manager approval.
